t: This release adds Smithy RPC v2 CBOR as an additional protocol alongside the existing AWS JSON 1.1. The SDK will prioritize its most performant protocol.

Amazon WorkSpaces Agent Access now supports domain-joined fleets for enterprise identity integration, real-time agent observation with instant stop controls, and MCP tool forwarding for lower-latency, cost-effective desktop tool access.
Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports BYOL (Bring Your Own License). This enables customers to import their own WorkSpaces images and use them in WorkSpaces Applications.

Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now enables AI agents to securely operate desktop applications. Administrators configure stacks to provide agents access to WorkSpaces. Agents can click, type, and take screenshots. Agents authenticate with AWS IAM credentials with activity logged in AWS CloudTrail.
Add content redirection to Update Stack

Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports drain mode for instances in multi-session fleets. This capability allows administrators to instruct individual fleet instances to stop accepting new user sessions while allowing existing sessions to continue uninterrupted.
Add support for URL Redirection
Adding new attribute to disable IMDS v1 APIs for fleet, Image Builder and AppBlockBuilder instances.
Added support for new operating systems (1) Ubuntu 24.04 Pro LTS on Elastic fleets, and (2) Microsoft Server 2025 on Always-On and On-Demand fleets
Adding support for additional instances and extended storage
AWS Appstream support for IPv6
This release introduces support for Microsoft license included applications streaming.
G6f instance support for AppStream 2.0
Added support for G6 instances
Added support for Certificate-Based Authentication on AppStream 2.0 multi-session fleets.
Add support for managing admin consent requirement on selected domains for OneDrive Storage Connectors in AppStream2.0.
Added support for Rocky Linux 8 on Amazon AppStream 2.0
Added support for Automatic Time Zone Redirection on Amazon AppStream 2.0
This release includes following new APIs: CreateThemeForStack, DescribeThemeForStack, UpdateThemeForStack, DeleteThemeForStack to support custom branding programmatically.
Added support for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 on Amazon AppStream 2.0
This release introduces configurable clipboard, allowing admins to specify the maximum length of text that can be copied by the users from their device to the remote session and vice-versa.
This release includes support for images of Windows Server 2022 platform.
This release introduces multi-session fleets, allowing customers to provision more than one user session on a single fleet instance.
This release introduces app block builder, allowing customers to provision a resource to package applications into an app block
This release introduces multi-session fleets, allowing customers to provision more than one user session on a single fleet instance.
This release introduces app block builder, allowing customers to provision a resource to package applications into an app block
Fixing the issue where Appstream waiters hang for fleet_started and fleet_stopped.
This release includes CertificateBasedAuthProperties in CreateDirectoryConfig and UpdateDirectoryConfig.
Includes support for StreamingExperienceSettings in CreateStack and UpdateStack APIs
Includes updates for create and update fleet APIs to manage the session scripts locations for Elastic fleets.
Includes APIs for App Entitlement management regarding entitlement and entitled application association.
Includes APIs for managing resources for Elastic fleets: applications, app blocks, and application-fleet associations.
This release includes support for images of AmazonLinux2 platform type.
This release provides support for image updates
